svg.title: The cache threshold is a dial with a price on it
svg.desc: A hand-drawn similarity axis from 0.85 to 1.00 with the band above 0.97 hachured green as SERVE FROM CACHE and the rest blue as GO TO THE PIPELINE, annotated at four thresholds with hit rate and wrong-answer rate: 0.99 gives 38% and 0.3%, 0.97 gives 45% and 1.4% and is highlighted, 0.95 gives 53% and 4.9%, and 0.92 gives 61% and 13.2% and is struck through as one in eight answers wrong. Two nearly identical return-policy queries with cosine 0.961 but different answers show what a false hit is, a cost waterfall shows generation input tokens at $0.00046 of a $0.00065 query, a single-flight sketch coalesces 340 concurrent requests to one generation, and four unlabelled sparklines show the refusal rate stepping up first.
svg.text: The cache threshold is a dial with a price on it
cosine similarity to the cached query
how many days to return goods?
how many days to return DEFECTIVE
different answers: 45 days vs 14. THIS is a false hit.
70% of the bill is INPUT tokens -
that is chunk_size x k. Week 27
